title: The Shadow Priest -- Beta
changeNote:
0.1.5 - Devour, Curse combos, and Surrender to Madness

- New keyword: Devour. Exhaust a Curse from your hand for a bonus; the base card still works without one.
- Devour now connects Tentacle Slam, Unfurling Darkness, Mind Trauma, Shadow Mend, Purify Disease, Focused Will, Twin Suns, and Void Ray. Purify Disease+ now has Retain; Artifact requires Devour.
- More Madness-fueled Curse generation: Shadow Word: Madness deals 9/13 damage and adds Mind Decay to hand. Madness Overwhelming starts at 10/15 Madness, retains its 5/8-per-Power scaling, and adds Mind Decay to discard.
- Surrender to Madness reworked: 0 Energy, unlocked only after leaving Voidform twice this combat. Enter permanent Voidform; gain 2/3 Strength and Mastery now and each turn. Die at the end of your fifth turn, counting the casting turn. Win before time runs out! Final-turn DoTs can save you, but revival effects cannot. Normal Voidform discounts replace free Attacks; the doubled incoming damage penalty is removed.
- Gold borders and conditional text now highlight available bonuses, including Devour, low-health Bulwark, useful dispels, Shadow Word: Death lethal targets, and Surrender's unlock.

Restart Slay the Spire after Steam downloads the update. Start a new run to try the full package. Thanks for the feedback!
